info.name: Microservices B2B-B2C Multivendor Marketplace - Complete API Collection
info.description: Comprehensive API collection for the Microservices B2B-B2C Multivendor Marketplace platform with all 21 microservices including REST APIs and WebSocket endpoints. Features authentication, products, transactions, messaging, notifications, advertising, ticketing, reviews, promotions, shipping, AI recommender, analytics, wishlist, search, SEO, loyalty, social features, enhanced analytics, and system management.
